suspicions.claim: The posts_url field is removed from user responses, so clients can no longer retrieve the URL to list a user's posts from the user object.
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /api/users/1 with a valid Bearer token; read the JSON response and confirm the 'posts_url' field is absent.
suspicions.evidence: GET /api/users/1 returned posts_url in base but not in head

suspicions.claim: The posts_url field is removed from the authenticated user's self-response.
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /api/me with a valid Bearer token; read the JSON response and confirm the 'posts_url' field is absent.
suspicions.evidence: GET /api/me returned posts_url in base but not in head across multiple probes

suspicions.claim: The posts_url field is removed from paginated user listings.
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /api/users with a valid Bearer token; read the JSON response and confirm each user object in 'data' lacks a 'posts_url' field.
suspicions.evidence: GET /api/users returned posts_url in each user object in base but not in head

suspicions.claim: The posts_url field is removed from follower/following listings.
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /api/users/1/followers with a valid Bearer token; read the JSON response and confirm each user object in 'data' lacks a 'posts_url' field.
suspicions.evidence: GET /api/users/1/followers returned posts_url in each user object in base but not in head

suspicions.claim: The posts_url field is removed from user objects embedded in post responses (author field).
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /api/posts/1 with a valid Bearer token; read the JSON response and confirm the 'author' object lacks a 'posts_url' field.
suspicions.evidence: GET /api/posts/1 returned author.posts_url in base but not in head
